notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 960 x 600, the option's root animation false.
the option is the gallery file with each '@name' the function the harvest namer named so (the page's own).
a later file of a sequence is merged with the options the page passed (setOption(option, opts)).
a paint (renderToSVGString) after every setOption builds every path and text block.

guards.name: bar trend: one polyline per category in the window
calendar icon: icons are paths fitted into 16 x 16 boxes
error bar: three lines per item
profit: a rect per item with an ec4 label
wind barb: arrows as paths and weather as images with texts
the geo effect: a pin path in every group
